question: Doanh thu theo phân khúc khách hàng
expected_sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(oi.item_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Top 5 danh mục có doanh thu cao nhất
expected_sql: SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(oi.item_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Số đơn hàng theo phân khúc khách hàng
expected_sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY orders DESC

question: Giá trị trung bình mỗi đơn theo thị trường
expected_sql: SELECT o.market, SUM(t.order_total) / COUNT(*) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(item_total) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t JOIN orders o ON t.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.market ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

question: Số khách hàng có đơn bị hủy theo quốc gia của khách hàng
expected_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'CANCELED' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY customers DESC

question: Tỷ lệ đơn có nguy cơ giao trễ theo phân khúc khách hàng
expected_sql: SELECT c.segment, AVG(CASE WHEN o.late_delivery_risk THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS late_rate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY late_rate DESC

question: Số lượng bán theo danh mục ở thị trường Europe
expected_sql: SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE o.market = 'Europe' GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY quantity DESC

question: Lợi nhuận theo phương thức vận chuyển và phân khúc khách hàng
expected_sql: SELECT o.shipping_mode, c.segment, SUM(oi.profit) AS profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY o.shipping_mode, c.segment ORDER BY o.shipping_mode, c.segment

question: Số sản phẩm theo bộ phận
expected_sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products p JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN departments d ON cat.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY products DESC

question: Số ngày giao hàng thực tế trung bình của đơn có sản phẩm thuộc danh mục Cleats
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(o.days_for_shipping_real) AS avg_days FROM orders o WHERE o.order_id IN (SELECT oi.order_id FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE cat.category_name = 'Cleats')
